src.title: Protein Crispy Bites with Sweet & Sour Built Sauce

recipes.title: Protein Crispy Bites (Beef & Rice Paper)

items.i: spring onion and sesame seeds, to garnish
Sweet & Sour Built Sauce (see the other recipe in this post)

steps: Filling
Mix the mince, carrot, coconut aminos, sesame oil, spring onion, ginger and garlic in a bowl.
Soften
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for a few seconds until just soft, then lay it flat.
Roll
Spread a third of the mince along the sheet, fold in the sides and roll it up tight. Repeat with the other 2.
Air fry
Cut each roll into 4 or 5 bites. Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy and cooked through.
Sauce
While they cook, blend the Sweet & Sour sauce.
Serve
Top with spring onion and sesame seeds, then dunk.
recipes.notes: Recipe, calories and protein are the creator's (per serving, from the recipe card). Carbs and fat are estimates. The macros don't seem to include the dipping sauce (about 66 cal per 2 tbsp). Coconut aminos keep it soy-free; the bites are dairy-free but the sauce is not.

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Built Sauce (Cottage Cheese)

items.i: sweet chilli sauce (Mingle, or any brand)
tomato sauce / ketchup (Mingle, or any brand)

steps: Blend
Add everything to a blender and blend until completely smooth.
Season
Taste and adjust the salt and pepper.
Bottle
Pour into a 200 ml squeezy bottle or an airtight jar.
Store
Keep in the fridge and use within 5 days. Shake before using.
recipes.notes: Recipe, calories and protein are the creator's (per 2 tbsp serve). Carbs and fat are estimates. Mingle is an Australian brand, so any sweet chilli sauce and tomato sauce (ketchup) work. Great on crispy bites, spring rolls and fried rice.
